findings.description: Legacy automation list/receipt/editor stress captures at 760px retain wide content beyond the viewport. The main native window enforces minWidth1040; the corresponding supported wide views are readable. This packet does not claim complete 760px adaptation for legacy automation pages.

Quick Chat source captures retain native transparency. Original alpha and separately composited Frost fallback inspection were reviewed; actual OS vibrancy/backdrop and installed-window appearance are not certified by this source packet.

coverageLimits: Source Electron with scripted cognition; no real-model provider timing or installed-build acceptance.
Keyboard/focus/layout and reduced-motion scenarios exercised; no screen-reader certification.
Native OS vibrancy of transparent Quick Chat is not certified by alpha PNG inspection.
Legacy 760px automation stress-layout limitation retained below the native 1040px minimum.
Legacy completion-report drawer remains a separate compatibility surface; new file/directory/web/Diff routes use tabbed workspace.
